Andrella.description:

Humano Capitã da Guarda

This captain is strong, stern, and just.

Postura Perfeita. Andrella is as strict with her posture as she is with the law.

Exemplo a Seguir. Many of the keep’s young people admire Andrella and enjoy her goodhearted mentorship.

Rumores

“A dastardly bandit, Pral, accosts travelers along the trail. Apparently he’s quite handsome; I’m sure he’ll look even better behind bars.” (Verdadeiro)

“The castellan tells me monsters are drawn to the Caves of Chaos in droves. I wonder why.” (Verdadeiro)

Bartho.name: Bartho
Bartho.description:
@Embed[JournalEntry.hotbArtHandouts0.JournalEntryPage.77W5x4kFgTpDB0CZ caption=false classes="right three"]

Humano Guarda do Portão

This gullible recruit spends more time dreaming than patrolling.

Distractable. Bartho is easily distracted from his post because he’d rather be doing anything else.

Sleepy. Bartho likes to catch a few winks during the night shift.

Rumores

“If you can’t afford a bed at the inn, Cornflower will let you sleep in the barn. The hay’s real comfy.” (Verdadeiro)

“Minotaurs aren’t real. They’re just a myth told to scare little children from wandering into caves.” (Falso)

Becoming a Clérigo …

As a Nível 1 Character

  • Gain all the traits in the Características Básicas do Clérigo table.
  • Gain the Clérigo's level 1 features, which are listed in the Clérigo Features table.

As a Multiclass Character

  • Gain the following traits from the Características Básicas do Clérigo table: Dado de Ponto de Vida and training with Armaduras Leves e Médias e Escudos.
  • Gain the Clérigo's level 1 features, which are listed in the Clérigo Features table. See the multiclassing rules in chapter 2 to determine your available spell slots.

Conjuração.name: Conjuração
Conjuração.description:
You have learned to cast spells through prayer and meditation. See @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.content24.JournalEntry.phbSpells0000000.JournalEntryPage.b2QVn25z2N1ykWpf]{chapter 7} for the rules on spellcasting. The information below details how you use those rules with Clérigo spells, which appear on the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.content24.JournalEntry.phbSpells0000000.JournalEntryPage.SkHptN2PTzFGDaEj]{Clérigo spell list}.

Truques. You know three cantrips of your choice from the Clérigo spell list. @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplGuidance00]{Guidance}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplSacredFlam]{Chama Sagrada}, and @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplThaumaturg]{Taumaturgia} are recommended.

Whenever you gain a Clérigo level, you can replace one of your cantrips with another cantrip of your choice from the Clérigo spell list.

When you reach Clérigo levels 4 and 10, you learn another cantrip of your choice from the Clérigo spell list, as shown in the Truques column of the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.content24.JournalEntry.phbCleric0000000.JournalEntryPage.acPyA6A4DQBSnuZB#class-features]{Clérigo Features} table.

Espaços de Magia. The Clérigo Features table shows how many spell slots you have to cast your level 1+ spells. You regain all expended slots when you finish a Descanso Longo.

Magias Preparadas of Nível 1+. You prepare the list of level 1+ spells that are available for you to cast with this feature. To start, choose four level 1 spells from the Clérigo spell list. @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplBless00000]{Bênção}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplCureWounds]{Curar Ferimentos}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplGuidingBol]{Raio Guiador}, and @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplShieldofFa]{Escudo da Fé} are recommended.

The number of spells on your list increases as you gain Clérigo levels, as shown in the Magias Preparadas column of the Clérigo Features table. Whenever that number increases, choose additional spells from the Clérigo spell list until the number of spells on your list matches the number on the table. The chosen spells must be of a level for which you have spell slots. For example, if you're a level 3 Clérigo, your list of prepared spells can include six spells of levels 1 and 2 in any combination.

If another Clérigo feature gives you spells that you always have prepared, those spells don't count against the number of spells you can prepare with this feature, but those spells otherwise count as Clérigo spells for you.

Changing Your Magias Preparadas. Whenever you finish a Descanso Longo, you can change your list of prepared spells, replacing any of the spells there with other Clérigo spells for which you have spell slots.

Atributo de Conjuração. Sabedoria is your spellcasting ability for your Clérigo spells.

Foco de Conjuração. You can use a Símbolo Sagrado as a Foco de Conjuração for your Clérigo spells.

Ordem Divina.name: Ordem Divina
Ordem Divina.description:
You have dedicated yourself to one of the following sacred roles of your choice.

Protetor. Trained for battle, you gain proficiency with Martial weapons and training with Heavy armor.

Taumaturgo. You know one extra cantrip from the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.content24.JournalEntry.phbSpells0000000.JournalEntryPage.SkHptN2PTzFGDaEj]{Clérigo spell list}. In addition, your mystical connection to the divine gives you a bonus to your Inteligência (Arcana or Religião) checks. The bonus equals your Sabedoria modifier (minimum of +1).

Nota do Foundry

During advancement you will be able to choose which option you prefer.

Ordem Divina: Taumaturgo.name: Ordem Divina: Taumaturgo
Ordem Divina: Taumaturgo.description:
You have dedicated yourself to the following sacred role:

Taumaturgo. You know one extra cantrip from the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.content24.JournalEntry.phbSpells0000000.JournalEntryPage.SkHptN2PTzFGDaEj]{Clérigo spell list}. In addition, your mystical connection to the divine gives you a bonus to your Inteligência (Arcana or Religião) checks. The bonus equals your Sabedoria modifier (minimum of +1, currently [[lookup @abilities.wis.mod]]).

Nota do Foundry

This feature includes an Efeito Ativo which increases the number of cantrips you can know and grants the bonus to your Inteligência (Arcana or Religião) checks.

Bênção.name: Bênção
Bênção.description:
You bless up to three criaturas dentro do alcance. Whenever a alvo makes an jogada de ataque or a teste de resistência before the spell ends, the alvo adds 1d4 to the jogada de ataque or save.

Usando um Espaço de Magia de Círculo Superior. You can alvo one additional criatura for each spell slot level above 1.

Blessed.name: Blessed
Blessed.description: Whenever a alvo makes an jogada de ataque or a teste de resistência before the spell ends, the alvo adds 1d4 to the jogada de ataque or save.

Curar Ferimentos.name: Curar Ferimentos
Curar Ferimentos.description:
A criatura you touch regains a number of Pontos de Vida equal to 2d8 plus your spellcasting ability modifier.

Usando um Espaço de Magia de Círculo Superior. The healing increases by 2d8 for each spell slot level above 1.

Raio Guiador.name: Raio Guiador
Raio Guiador.description:
You hurl a bolt of light toward a criatura dentro do alcance. Make a ranged spell attack against the alvo. On a hit, it takes 4d6 dano radiante, and the next jogada de ataque made against it before the end of your next turn has Vantagem.

Usando um Espaço de Magia de Círculo Superior. The damage increases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above 1.

Raio Guiador.name: Raio Guiador
Raio Guiador.description: The next jogada de ataque made against the alvo before the end of your next turn has Vantagem.

Light.name: Light
Light.description:
You touch one Large or smaller object that isn't being worn or carried by someone else. Until the spell ends, the object sheds Luz Plena in a 20-foot radius and Luz Fraca for an additional 20 feet. The light can be colored as you like.

Covering the object with something opaque blocks the light. The spell ends if you cast it again.

Chama Sagrada.name: Chama Sagrada
Chama Sagrada.description:
Flame-like radiance descends on a criatura that you can see dentro do alcance. The alvo must succeed on a Dexterity teste de resistência or take 1d8 dano radiante. The alvo gains no benefit from Meia Cobertura or Três Quartos de Cobertura for this save.

Aprimoramento de Truque. The damage increases by 1d8 when you reach levels 5 (2d8), 11 (3d8), and 17 (4d8).

Escudo da Fé.name: Escudo da Fé
Escudo da Fé.description: A shimmering field surrounds a criatura of your choice dentro do alcance, granting it a +2 bonus to AC for the duration.

Shimmering Field.name: Shimmering Field
Shimmering Field.description: The alvo gains a +2 bonus to AC for the duration.

Taumaturgia.name: Taumaturgia
Taumaturgia.description:
You manifest a minor wonder dentro do alcance. You create one of the effects below dentro do alcance. If you cast this spell multiple times, you can have up to three of its 1-minute effects active at a time.

Altered Eyes. You alter the appearance of your eyes for 1 minute.

Booming Voice. Your voice booms up to three times as loud as normal for 1 minute. For the duration, you have Vantagem on [[/check ability=cha skill=itm]] checks.

Fire Play. You cause flames to flicker, brighten, dim, or change color for 1 minute.

Tremors. You cause harmless tremors in the ground for 1 minute.

Dobrar dos Mortos.name: Dobrar dos Mortos
Dobrar dos Mortos.description:
You point at one criatura you can see dentro do alcance, and the single chime of a dolorous bell is audible within 10 feet of the alvo. The alvo must succeed on a Sabedoria teste de resistência or take 1d8 dano necrótico. If the alvo is missing any of its Pontos de Vida, it instead takes 1d12 dano necrótico.

Aprimoramento de Truque. The damage increases by one die when you reach levels 5 (2d8 or 2d12), 11 (3d8 or 3d12), and 17 (4d8 or 4d12).

Canalizar Divindade.name: Canalizar Divindade
Canalizar Divindade.description:
You can channel divine energy directly from the Planos Exteriores to fuel magical effects. You start with two such effects: Centelha Divina and Expulsar Mortos-Vivos, each of which is described below. Each time you use this class's Canalizar Divindade, choose which Canalizar Divindade effect from this class to create. You gain additional effect options at higher Clérigo levels.

You can use this class's Canalizar Divindade twice. You regain one of its expended uses when you finish a Descanso Curto, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Descanso Longo. You gain additional uses when you reach certain Clérigo levels, as shown in the Canalizar Divindade column of the Clérigo Features table.

If a Canalizar Divindade effect requires a teste de resistência, the DC equals the spell save DC from this class's Conjuração feature.

Centelha Divina. As a Ação Mágica, you point your Símbolo Sagrado at another criatura you can see within 30 feet of yourself and focus divine energy at it. Roll 1d8 and add your Sabedoria modifier. You either restore Pontos de Vida to the criatura equal to that total or force the criatura to make a Constitution teste de resistência. On a failed save, the criatura takes Necrótico or dano radiante (your choice) equal to that total. On a successful save, the criatura takes half as much damage (round down).

You roll an additional d8 when you reach Clérigo levels 7 (2d8), 13 (3d8), and 18 (4d8).

Expulsar Mortos-Vivos. As a Ação Mágica, you present your Símbolo Sagrado and censure Morto-vivo criaturas. Each Morto-vivo of your choice within 30 feet of you must make a Sabedoria teste de resistência. If the criatura fails its save, it has the Amedrontado and Incapacitado conditions for 1 minute. For that duration, it tries to move as far from you as it can on its turns. This effect ends early on the criatura if it takes any damage, if you have the Incapacitado condition, or if you die.

Nota do Foundry

This feature will automatically restore 1 use on a Descanso Curto and all on a Descanso Longo. The uses scale automatically as you level up.

The Centelha Divina: Heal activity includes the healing effect.

The Centelha Divina: Save activity includes the teste de resistência.

The Expulsar Mortos-Vivos activity includes an Efeito Ativo that applies the Amedrontado and Incapacitado conditions.

Infligir Ferimentos.name: Infligir Ferimentos
Infligir Ferimentos.description:
A criatura you touch makes a Constitution teste de resistência, taking 2d10 dano necrótico on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

Usando um Espaço de Magia de Círculo Superior. The damage increases by 1d10 for each spell slot level above 1.

Palavra Curativa.name: Palavra Curativa
Palavra Curativa.description:
A criatura of your choice that you can see dentro do alcance regains Pontos de Vida equal to 2d4 plus your spellcasting ability modifier.

Usando um Espaço de Magia de Círculo Superior. The healing increases by 2d4 for each spell slot level above 1.

Santuário.name: Santuário
Santuário.description: You ward a criatura dentro do alcance. Until the spell ends, any criatura who targets the warded criatura with an jogada de ataque or a damaging spell must succeed on a [[/save ability=wis dc=@attributes.spell.dc format=long]] or either choose a new alvo or lose the attack or spell. This spell doesn't protect the warded criatura from areas of effect. The spell ends if the warded criatura makes an jogada de ataque, casts a spell, or deals damage.

Warded.name: Warded
Warded.description:
Until the spell ends, any criatura who targets the warded criatura with an jogada de ataque or a damaging spell must succeed on a [[/save ability=wis format=long]] or either choose a new alvo or lose the attack or spell.

The spell ends if the warded criatura makes an jogada de ataque, casts a spell, or deals damage.

Arma Espiritual.name: Arma Espiritual
Arma Espiritual.description:
You create a floating, spectral force that resembles a weapon of your choice and lasts for the duration. The force appears dentro do alcance in a space of your choice, and you can immediately make one melee spell attack against one criatura within 5 feet of the force. On a hit, the alvo takes Force damage equal to 1d8 plus your spellcasting ability modifier.

As a Ação Bônus on your later turns, you can move the force up to 20 feet and repeat the attack against a criatura within 5 feet of it.

Usando um Espaço de Magia de Círculo Superior. The damage increases by 1d8 for every slot level above 2.

Domínio da Luz.name: Domínio da Luz
Domínio da Luz.description:
Bring Light to Banish Darkness

The Domínio da Luz emphasizes the divine power to bring about blazing fire and revelation. Clerics who wield this power are enlightened souls infused with radiance and the power of their deities' discerning vision, charged with chasing away lies and burning away darkness.

The Domínio da Luz is associated with gods of truth, vigilance, beauty, insight, and renewal. Some of these gods are identified with the sun or as charioteers who guide the sun across the sky. Others are sentinels who pierce deception. Some are deities of beauty and artistry who teach that art is a vehicle for the soul's improvement.

Mãos Flamejantes.name: Mãos Flamejantes
Mãos Flamejantes.description:
A thin sheet of flames shoots forth from you. Each criatura in a 15-foot Cone makes a Dexterity teste de resistência, taking 3d6 dano de fogo on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

Flammable objects in the Cone that aren't being worn or carried start burning.

Usando um Espaço de Magia de Círculo Superior. The damage increases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above 1.

Fogo das Fadas.name: Fogo das Fadas
Fogo das Fadas.description:
Objects in a 20-foot Cubo dentro do alcance are outlined in blue, green, or violet light (your choice). Each criatura in the Cubo is also outlined if it fails a Dexterity teste de resistência. For the duration, objects and affected criaturas shed &Reference[dimlight] in a 10-foot radius and can't benefit from the Invisível condition.

Attack rolls against an affected criatura or object have Vantagem if the attacker can see it.

Outlined.name: Outlined
Outlined.description:
For the duration, objects and affected criaturas shed &Reference[dimlight] in a 10-foot radius and can’t benefit from the Invisível condition.

Attack rolls against an affected criatura or object have Vantagem if the attacker can see it.

Raio Ardente.name: Raio Ardente
Raio Ardente.description:
You hurl three fiery rays. You can hurl them at one alvo dentro do alcance or at several. Make a ranged spell attack for each ray. On a hit, the alvo takes 2d6 dano de fogo.

Usando um Espaço de Magia de Círculo Superior. You create one additional ray for each spell slot level above 2.

Ver o Invisível.name: Ver o Invisível
Ver o Invisível.description: For the duration, you see criaturas and objects that have the &Reference[invisible apply=false] condition as if they were visible, and you can see into the Plano Etéreo. Creatures and objects there appear ghostly.

Domínio da Luz Spells.description:
Your connection to this divine domain ensures you always have certain spells ready. When you reach a Clérigo level specified in the Domínio da Luz Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

Radiância da Aurora.name: Radiância da Aurora
Radiância da Aurora.description: As a Ação Mágica, you present your Símbolo Sagrado and expend a use of your Canalizar Divindade to emit a flash of light in a 30-foot Emanation originating from yourself. Any magical &Reference[Darkness]—such as that created by the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplDarkness00]{Darkness} spell—in that area is dispelled. Additionally, each criatura of your choice in that area must make a Constitution teste de resistência, taking dano radiante equal to 2d10 plus your Clérigo level on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

Clarão Protetor.name: Clarão Protetor
Clarão Protetor.description:
When a criatura that you can see within 30 feet of yourself makes an jogada de ataque, you can take a Reação to impose Desvantagem on the jogada de ataque, causing light to flare before it hits or misses.

You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Sabedoria modifier (minimum of once, currently [[lookup @abilities.wis.mod]]). You regain all expended uses when you finish a Descanso Longo.

Nota do Foundry

The Flare activity includes a 30 foot emanation for identifying impacted criaturas. It does not automate the Desvantagem.

Becoming a Clérigo …

As a Nível 1 Character

  • Gain all the traits in the Características Básicas do Clérigo table.
  • Gain the Clérigo's level 1 features, which are listed in the Clérigo Features table.

As a Multiclass Character

  • Gain the following traits from the Características Básicas do Clérigo table: Dado de Ponto de Vida and training with Armaduras Leves e Médias e Escudos.
  • Gain the Clérigo's level 1 features, which are listed in the Clérigo Features table. See the multiclassing rules in chapter 2 to determine your available spell slots.

Conjuração.name: Conjuração
Conjuração.description:
You have learned to cast spells through prayer and meditation. See @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.content24.JournalEntry.phbSpells0000000.JournalEntryPage.b2QVn25z2N1ykWpf]{chapter 7} for the rules on spellcasting. The information below details how you use those rules with Clérigo spells, which appear on the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.content24.JournalEntry.phbSpells0000000.JournalEntryPage.SkHptN2PTzFGDaEj]{Clérigo spell list}.

Truques. You know three cantrips of your choice from the Clérigo spell list. @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplGuidance00]{Guidance}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplSacredFlam]{Chama Sagrada}, and @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplThaumaturg]{Taumaturgia} are recommended.

Whenever you gain a Clérigo level, you can replace one of your cantrips with another cantrip of your choice from the Clérigo spell list.

When you reach Clérigo levels 4 and 10, you learn another cantrip of your choice from the Clérigo spell list, as shown in the Truques column of the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.content24.JournalEntry.phbCleric0000000.JournalEntryPage.acPyA6A4DQBSnuZB#class-features]{Clérigo Features} table.

Espaços de Magia. The Clérigo Features table shows how many spell slots you have to cast your level 1+ spells. You regain all expended slots when you finish a Descanso Longo.

Magias Preparadas of Nível 1+. You prepare the list of level 1+ spells that are available for you to cast with this feature. To start, choose four level 1 spells from the Clérigo spell list. @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplBless00000]{Bênção}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplCureWounds]{Curar Ferimentos}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplGuidingBol]{Raio Guiador}, and @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplShieldofFa]{Escudo da Fé} are recommended.

The number of spells on your list increases as you gain Clérigo levels, as shown in the Magias Preparadas column of the Clérigo Features table. Whenever that number increases, choose additional spells from the Clérigo spell list until the number of spells on your list matches the number on the table. The chosen spells must be of a level for which you have spell slots. For example, if you're a level 3 Clérigo, your list of prepared spells can include six spells of levels 1 and 2 in any combination.

If another Clérigo feature gives you spells that you always have prepared, those spells don't count against the number of spells you can prepare with this feature, but those spells otherwise count as Clérigo spells for you.

Changing Your Magias Preparadas. Whenever you finish a Descanso Longo, you can change your list of prepared spells, replacing any of the spells there with other Clérigo spells for which you have spell slots.

Atributo de Conjuração. Sabedoria is your spellcasting ability for your Clérigo spells.

Foco de Conjuração. You can use a Símbolo Sagrado as a Foco de Conjuração for your Clérigo spells.

Ordem Divina.name: Ordem Divina
Ordem Divina.description:
You have dedicated yourself to one of the following sacred roles of your choice.

Protetor. Trained for battle, you gain proficiency with Martial weapons and training with Heavy armor.

Taumaturgo. You know one extra cantrip from the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.content24.JournalEntry.phbSpells0000000.JournalEntryPage.SkHptN2PTzFGDaEj]{Clérigo spell list}. In addition, your mystical connection to the divine gives you a bonus to your Inteligência (Arcana or Religião) checks. The bonus equals your Sabedoria modifier (minimum of +1).

Nota do Foundry

During advancement you will be able to choose which option you prefer.

Ordem Divina: Taumaturgo.name: Ordem Divina: Taumaturgo
Ordem Divina: Taumaturgo.description:
You have dedicated yourself to the following sacred role:

Taumaturgo. You know one extra cantrip from the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.content24.JournalEntry.phbSpells0000000.JournalEntryPage.SkHptN2PTzFGDaEj]{Clérigo spell list}. In addition, your mystical connection to the divine gives you a bonus to your Inteligência (Arcana or Religião) checks. The bonus equals your Sabedoria modifier (minimum of +1, currently [[lookup @abilities.wis.mod]]).

Nota do Foundry

This feature includes an Efeito Ativo which increases the number of cantrips you can know and grants the bonus to your Inteligência (Arcana or Religião) checks.

Bênção.name: Bênção
Bênção.description:
You bless up to three criaturas dentro do alcance. Whenever a alvo makes an jogada de ataque or a teste de resistência before the spell ends, the alvo adds 1d4 to the jogada de ataque or save.

Usando um Espaço de Magia de Círculo Superior. You can alvo one additional criatura for each spell slot level above 1.

Blessed.name: Blessed
Blessed.description: Whenever a alvo makes an jogada de ataque or a teste de resistência before the spell ends, the alvo adds 1d4 to the jogada de ataque or save.

Curar Ferimentos.name: Curar Ferimentos
Curar Ferimentos.description:
A criatura you touch regains a number of Pontos de Vida equal to 2d8 plus your spellcasting ability modifier.

Usando um Espaço de Magia de Círculo Superior. The healing increases by 2d8 for each spell slot level above 1.

Raio Guiador.name: Raio Guiador
Raio Guiador.description:
You hurl a bolt of light toward a criatura dentro do alcance. Make a ranged spell attack against the alvo. On a hit, it takes 4d6 dano radiante, and the next jogada de ataque made against it before the end of your next turn has Vantagem.

Usando um Espaço de Magia de Círculo Superior. The damage increases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above 1.

Raio Guiador.name: Raio Guiador
Raio Guiador.description: The next jogada de ataque made against the alvo before the end of your next turn has Vantagem.

Light.name: Light
Light.description:
You touch one Large or smaller object that isn't being worn or carried by someone else. Until the spell ends, the object sheds Luz Plena in a 20-foot radius and Luz Fraca for an additional 20 feet. The light can be colored as you like.

Covering the object with something opaque blocks the light. The spell ends if you cast it again.

Chama Sagrada.name: Chama Sagrada
Chama Sagrada.description:
Flame-like radiance descends on a criatura that you can see dentro do alcance. The alvo must succeed on a Dexterity teste de resistência or take 1d8 dano radiante. The alvo gains no benefit from Meia Cobertura or Três Quartos de Cobertura for this save.

Aprimoramento de Truque. The damage increases by 1d8 when you reach levels 5 (2d8), 11 (3d8), and 17 (4d8).

Escudo da Fé.name: Escudo da Fé
Escudo da Fé.description: A shimmering field surrounds a criatura of your choice dentro do alcance, granting it a +2 bonus to AC for the duration.

Shimmering Field.name: Shimmering Field
Shimmering Field.description: The alvo gains a +2 bonus to AC for the duration.

Taumaturgia.name: Taumaturgia
Taumaturgia.description:
You manifest a minor wonder dentro do alcance. You create one of the effects below dentro do alcance. If you cast this spell multiple times, you can have up to three of its 1-minute effects active at a time.

Altered Eyes. You alter the appearance of your eyes for 1 minute.

Booming Voice. Your voice booms up to three times as loud as normal for 1 minute. For the duration, you have Vantagem on [[/check ability=cha skill=itm]] checks.

Fire Play. You cause flames to flicker, brighten, dim, or change color for 1 minute.

Tremors. You cause harmless tremors in the ground for 1 minute.

Dobrar dos Mortos.name: Dobrar dos Mortos
Dobrar dos Mortos.description:
You point at one criatura you can see dentro do alcance, and the single chime of a dolorous bell is audible within 10 feet of the alvo. The alvo must succeed on a Sabedoria teste de resistência or take 1d8 dano necrótico. If the alvo is missing any of its Pontos de Vida, it instead takes 1d12 dano necrótico.

Aprimoramento de Truque. The damage increases by one die when you reach levels 5 (2d8 or 2d12), 11 (3d8 or 3d12), and 17 (4d8 or 4d12).

Canalizar Divindade.name: Canalizar Divindade
Canalizar Divindade.description:
You can channel divine energy directly from the Planos Exteriores to fuel magical effects. You start with two such effects: Centelha Divina and Expulsar Mortos-Vivos, each of which is described below. Each time you use this class's Canalizar Divindade, choose which Canalizar Divindade effect from this class to create. You gain additional effect options at higher Clérigo levels.

You can use this class's Canalizar Divindade twice. You regain one of its expended uses when you finish a Descanso Curto, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Descanso Longo. You gain additional uses when you reach certain Clérigo levels, as shown in the Canalizar Divindade column of the Clérigo Features table.

If a Canalizar Divindade effect requires a teste de resistência, the DC equals the spell save DC from this class's Conjuração feature.

Centelha Divina. As a Ação Mágica, you point your Símbolo Sagrado at another criatura you can see within 30 feet of yourself and focus divine energy at it. Roll 1d8 and add your Sabedoria modifier. You either restore Pontos de Vida to the criatura equal to that total or force the criatura to make a Constitution teste de resistência. On a failed save, the criatura takes Necrótico or dano radiante (your choice) equal to that total. On a successful save, the criatura takes half as much damage (round down).

You roll an additional d8 when you reach Clérigo levels 7 (2d8), 13 (3d8), and 18 (4d8).

Expulsar Mortos-Vivos. As a Ação Mágica, you present your Símbolo Sagrado and censure Morto-vivo criaturas. Each Morto-vivo of your choice within 30 feet of you must make a Sabedoria teste de resistência. If the criatura fails its save, it has the Amedrontado and Incapacitado conditions for 1 minute. For that duration, it tries to move as far from you as it can on its turns. This effect ends early on the criatura if it takes any damage, if you have the Incapacitado condition, or if you die.

Nota do Foundry

This feature will automatically restore 1 use on a Descanso Curto and all on a Descanso Longo. The uses scale automatically as you level up.

The Centelha Divina: Heal activity includes the healing effect.

The Centelha Divina: Save activity includes the teste de resistência.

The Expulsar Mortos-Vivos activity includes an Efeito Ativo that applies the Amedrontado and Incapacitado conditions.

Infligir Ferimentos.name: Infligir Ferimentos
Infligir Ferimentos.description:
A criatura you touch makes a Constitution teste de resistência, taking 2d10 dano necrótico on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

Usando um Espaço de Magia de Círculo Superior. The damage increases by 1d10 for each spell slot level above 1.

The Centelha Divina: Save activity includes the teste de resistência.

The Expulsar Mortos-Vivos activity includes an Efeito Ativo that applies the Amedrontado and Incapacitado conditions.

Infligir Ferimentos.name: Infligir Ferimentos
Infligir Ferimentos.description:
A criatura you touch makes a Constitution teste de resistência, taking 2d10 dano necrótico on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

Usando um Espaço de Magia de Círculo Superior. The damage increases by 1d10 for each spell slot level above 1.

Domínio da Vida.name: Domínio da Vida
Domínio da Vida.description:
Soothe the Hurts of the World

The Domínio da Vida focuses on the positive energy that helps sustain all life in the multiverse. Clerics who tap into this domain are masters of healing, using that life force to cure many hurts.

Existence itself relies on the positive energy associated with this domain, so a Clérigo of almost any religious tradition might choose it. This domain is particularly associated with agricultural deities, gods of healing or endurance, and gods of home and community. Religious orders of healing also seek the magic of this domain.

Aid.name: Aid
Aid.description:
Escolha up to three criaturas dentro do alcance. Each alvo's Hit Point maximum and current Pontos de Vida increase by 5 for the duration.

Usando um Espaço de Magia de Círculo Superior. Each alvo's Pontos de Vida increase by 5 for each spell slot level above 2.

Nota do Foundry

The default Heal activity is configured with multiple Active Effects representing the temporary maximum Pontos de Vida provided by this spell.

Users should apply the appropriate Efeito Ativo for the spell slot level used in the casting of this spell.

Nível 2: +5 Max HP.description: The alvo's Hit Point maximum is increased for the duration.

Nível 3: +10 Max HP.description: The alvo's Hit Point maximum is increased for the duration.

Nível 4: +15 Max HP.description: The alvo's Hit Point maximum is increased for the duration.

Nível 9: +40 Max HP.description: The alvo's Hit Point maximum is increased for the duration.

Curar Ferimentos.name: Curar Ferimentos
Curar Ferimentos.description:
A criatura you touch regains a number of Pontos de Vida equal to 2d8 plus your spellcasting ability modifier.

Usando um Espaço de Magia de Círculo Superior. The healing increases by 2d8 for each spell slot level above 1.

Lesser Restoration.name: Lesser Restoration
Lesser Restoration.description: You touch a criatura and end one condition on it: &Reference[blinded], &Reference[deafened], &Reference[paralyzed], or &Reference[poisoned].

Bênção.name: Bênção
Bênção.description:
You bless up to three criaturas dentro do alcance. Whenever a alvo makes an jogada de ataque or a teste de resistência before the spell ends, the alvo adds 1d4 to the jogada de ataque or save.

Usando um Espaço de Magia de Círculo Superior. You can alvo one additional criatura for each spell slot level above 1.

Blessed.name: Blessed
Blessed.description: Whenever a alvo makes an jogada de ataque or a teste de resistência before the spell ends, the alvo adds 1d4 to the jogada de ataque or save.

Disciple of Life.name: Disciple of Life
Disciple of Life.description:
When a spell you cast with a spell slot restores Pontos de Vida to a criatura, that criatura regains additional Pontos de Vida on the turn you cast the spell. The additional Pontos de Vida equal 2 plus the spell slot's level.

Nota do Foundry

This feature includes a healing activity. Set the scale to the spell slot level you cast and it will provide a healing roll for you.

Domínio da Vida Spells.name: Domínio da Vida Spells
Domínio da Vida Spells.description:
Your connection to this divine domain ensures you always have certain spells ready. When you reach a Clérigo level specified in the Domínio da Vida Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

Preserve Life.name: Preserve Life
Preserve Life.description:
As a Ação Mágica, you present your Símbolo Sagrado and expend a use of your Canalizar Divindade to evoke healing energy that can restore a number of Pontos de Vida equal to five times your Clérigo level. Escolha &Reference[Bloodied] criaturas within 30 feet of yourself (which can include you), and divide those Pontos de Vida among them. This feature can restore a criatura to no more than half its Hit Point maximum.

Nota do Foundry

The Heal activity does not automatically restrict the HP gained to 50% of the alvo's max.

Palavra Curativa.name: Palavra Curativa
Palavra Curativa.description:
A criatura of your choice that you can see dentro do alcance regains Pontos de Vida equal to 2d4 plus your spellcasting ability modifier.

Usando um Espaço de Magia de Círculo Superior. The healing increases by 2d4 for each spell slot level above 1.

Santuário.name: Santuário
Santuário.description: You ward a criatura dentro do alcance. Until the spell ends, any criatura who targets the warded criatura with an jogada de ataque or a damaging spell must succeed on a [[/save ability=wis dc=@attributes.spell.dc format=long]] or either choose a new alvo or lose the attack or spell. This spell doesn't protect the warded criatura from areas of effect. The spell ends if the warded criatura makes an jogada de ataque, casts a spell, or deals damage.

Warded.name: Warded
Warded.description:
Until the spell ends, any criatura who targets the warded criatura with an jogada de ataque or a damaging spell must succeed on a [[/save ability=wis format=long]] or either choose a new alvo or lose the attack or spell.

The spell ends if the warded criatura makes an jogada de ataque, casts a spell, or deals damage.

Arma Espiritual.name: Arma Espiritual
Arma Espiritual.description:
You create a floating, spectral force that resembles a weapon of your choice and lasts for the duration. The force appears dentro do alcance in a space of your choice, and you can immediately make one melee spell attack against one criatura within 5 feet of the force. On a hit, the alvo takes Force damage equal to 1d8 plus your spellcasting ability modifier.

As a Ação Bônus on your later turns, you can move the force up to 20 feet and repeat the attack against a criatura within 5 feet of it.

Usando um Espaço de Magia de Círculo Superior. The damage increases by 1d8 for every slot level above 2.

Cornflower.name: Cornflower
Cornflower.description:
@Embed[JournalEntry.hotbArtHandouts0.JournalEntryPage.vJoRnCEcsA3SRrHM caption=false classes="right three"]

Halfling Barn Hand

This spunky stable hand isn’t afraid to get her hands dirty.

Animal Lover. Cornflower’s best friends are all barn animals.

Idiomatic. Cornflower likes to use animal idioms, such as “busy bee,” “chicken out,” and “hold your horses.”

Rumores

“Did you know animals have all sorts of special glands? Giant fire beetles are like big glowing cave lanterns! Isn’t nature amazing?” (Verdadeiro)

“Careful if you go trekking into the wilderness. The tamaracks are overrun with giant spiders.” (Verdadeiro)

Training.name: Training
Training.description: The [[lookup @name lowercase]] has a +2 bonus to one skill of the DM’s choice and has Vantagem whenever it makes an ability check using that skill.

Curate.name: Curate
Curate.description:
Pious Healer

A curate earns a special connection to the divine through service to shrines and temples. This devotion endows these spiritual leaders with the power to heal injuries, repel evil, and raise the dead.

Magic Resistance.name: Magic Resistance
Magic Resistance.description: The [[lookup @name lowercase]] has Vantagem on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The [[lookup @name lowercase]] makes three [[/item Celestial Radiance]] attacks.

Raise the Dead.name: Raise the Dead
Raise the Dead.description:
In a ritual that takes 8 hours, the [[lookup @name]] touches a criatura that has died within the past 7 days.

That criatura returns to life with 1 Hit Point. The curate canʼt revive a criatura that died of old age.

Healer's Touch.name: Healer's Touch
Healer's Touch.description: The [[lookup @name]] touches another criatura. That criatura regains [[/healing]] Pontos de Vida.

Dwern.name: Dwern
Dwern.description:
@Embed[JournalEntry.hotbArtHandouts0.JournalEntryPage.vpaiuOwQyN52gXQo caption=false classes="right three"]

Dwarf Scribe

This gruff scribe prefers the company of books over people.

Bookworm. Dwern has read more books than anyone else in the keep.

Curmudgeonly. Dwern is ill-tempered toward younger people—which, to him, are most people.

Rumores

“The guild house’s library boasts a modest but impressive collection of books on history and magic.” (Verdadeiro)

“There’s an ancient statue somewhere in the forests north of the keep. It was once the site of strange rituals. Some say it still is.” (Verdadeiro)

Parry.name: Parry
Parry.description: Trigger: The [[lookup @name lowercase]] is [[lookup @activation.condition activity=aLG3BRZL7P6OEjwd]]. Response: The [[lookup @name lowercase]] adds [[lookup @roll.formula activity=aLG3BRZL7P6OEjwd]] to its AC against that attack, possibly causing it to miss.

Elandra.name: Elandra
Elandra.description:
@Embed[JournalEntry.hotbArtHandouts0.JournalEntryPage.XiQhoH6verFXNJRZ caption=false classes="right three"]

Elf Adviser

Elandra provides guidance to the castellan and citizens of the keep.

Cautious. When presented with a choice, Elandra typically prefers the option with the least amount of risk.

Complainer. Nothing is ever good enough for Elandra.

Rumores

“Every night, the tavern hosts a rowdy little drinking game with prizes. It’s not for me.” (Verdadeiro)

“Kalista, the keep’s blacksmith, doesn’t sell weapons to adventurers. If you want to know why, ask her.” (Verdadeiro)

Fazzir.name: Fazzir
Fazzir.description:
@Embed[JournalEntry.hotbArtHandouts0.JournalEntryPage.AgXkGN9VdcYEkobx caption=false classes="right three"]

Humano Priest

This spiritual leader offers counsel and healing to all who seek the temple.

Altruistic. Fazzir puts the needs of others before his own.

Trusting. Fazzir always assumes the best of people.

Rumores

“The keep’s former priest, Ivlis, left a large collection of books on all matter of subjects—even occult rituals.” (Verdadeiro)

“Anyone entering the inner bailey is bound to cross paths with Shannik, sergeant of the guard. I think he’s a little too hard on new recruits.” (Verdadeiro)

Fighting Style.name: Fighting Style
Fighting Style.description:
You have honed your martial prowess and gain a @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.content24.JournalEntry.phbFeats00000000.JournalEntryPage.sbHImaCB8ZMEHYkb]{Fighting Style feat} of your choice. @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.feats24.Item.phbfstDefense000]{Defense} is recommended.

Whenever you gain a Guerreiro level, you can replace the feat you chose with a different Fighting Style feat.

Second Wind.name: Second Wind
Second Wind.description:
You have a limited well of physical and mental stamina that you can draw on. As a Ação Bônus, you can use it to regain Pontos de Vida equal to 1d10 plus your Guerreiro level.

You can use this feature twice. You regain one expended use when you finish a Descanso Curto, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Descanso Longo.

When you reach certain Guerreiro levels, you gain more uses of this feature, as shown in the Second Wind column of the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.content24.JournalEntry.phbFighter000000.JournalEntryPage.wDELe3k25FQvYdrq#class-features]{Guerreiro Features} table.

Nota do Foundry

This feature automatically scales in usage and recovers the correct number of uses on a Short and Descanso Longo.

Weapon Mastery.name: Weapon Mastery
Weapon Mastery.description:
Your training with weapons allows you to use the mastery properties of three kinds of Simple or Martial weapons of your choice. Whenever you finish a Descanso Longo, you can practice weapon drills and change one of those weapon choices.

When you reach certain Guerreiro levels, you gain the ability to use the mastery properties of more kinds of weapons, as shown in the Weapon Mastery column of the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.content24.JournalEntry.phbFighter000000.JournalEntryPage.wDELe3k25FQvYdrq#class-features]{Guerreiro Features} table.

Nota do Foundry

To change your masteries toggle on the "Edit" mode of your sheet. On the "Details" tab click on the cog icon next to "Weapons" in the bottom right. You can place a check in the mastery column of your chosen weapons.

You can push yourself beyond your normal limits for a moment. On your turn, you can take one additional action, except the Ação Mágica.

Once you use this feature, you can't do so again until you finish a Short or Descanso Longo. Starting at level 17, you can use it twice before a rest but only once on a turn.

Nota do Foundry

This feature includes a limited use that increases automatically at level 17.

Tactical Mind.name: Tactical Mind
Tactical Mind.description: You have a mind for tactics on and off the battlefield. When you fail an ability check, you can expend a use of your Second Wind to push yourself toward success. Rather than regaining Pontos de Vida, you roll 1d10 and add the number rolled to the ability check, potentially turning it into a success. If the check still fails, this use of Second Wind isn't expended.

When you reach certain Guerreiro levels, you gain more uses of this feature, as shown in the Second Wind column of the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.content24.JournalEntry.phbFighter000000.JournalEntryPage.wDELe3k25FQvYdrq#class-features]{Guerreiro Features} table.

Nota do Foundry

This feature automatically scales in usage and recovers the correct number of uses on a Short and Descanso Longo.

Weapon Mastery.name: Weapon Mastery
Weapon Mastery.description:
Your training with weapons allows you to use the mastery properties of three kinds of Simple or Martial weapons of your choice. Whenever you finish a Descanso Longo, you can practice weapon drills and change one of those weapon choices.

When you reach certain Guerreiro levels, you gain the ability to use the mastery properties of more kinds of weapons, as shown in the Weapon Mastery column of the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.content24.JournalEntry.phbFighter000000.JournalEntryPage.wDELe3k25FQvYdrq#class-features]{Guerreiro Features} table.

Nota do Foundry

To change your masteries toggle on the "Edit" mode of your sheet. On the "Details" tab click on the cog icon next to "Weapons" in the bottom right. You can place a check in the mastery column of your chosen weapons.

Action Surge.name: Action Surge
Action Surge.description:
You can push yourself beyond your normal limits for a moment. On your turn, you can take one additional action, except the Ação Mágica.

Once you use this feature, you can't do so again until you finish a Short or Descanso Longo. Starting at level 17, you can use it twice before a rest but only once on a turn.

Nota do Foundry

This feature includes a limited use that increases automatically at level 17.

Tactical Mind.name: Tactical Mind
Tactical Mind.description: You have a mind for tactics on and off the battlefield. When you fail an ability check, you can expend a use of your Second Wind to push yourself toward success. Rather than regaining Pontos de Vida, you roll 1d10 and add the number rolled to the ability check, potentially turning it into a success. If the check still fails, this use of Second Wind isn't expended.

Champion.name: Champion
Champion.description:
Pursue Physical Excellence in Combat

A Champion focuses on the development of martial prowess in a relentless pursuit of victory. Champions combine rigorous training with physical excellence to deal devastating blows, withstand peril, and garner glory. Whether in athletic contests or bloody battle, Champions strive for the crown of the victor.

Improved Critical.name: Improved Critical
Improved Critical.description:
Your attack rolls with weapons and Unarmed Strikes can score a Critical Hit on a roll of 19 or 20 on the d20.

Nota do Foundry

This feature automatically increases the Critical Hit threshold to 19.

Remarkable Athlete.name: Remarkable Athlete
Remarkable Athlete.description:
Thanks to your athleticism, you have Vantagem on Initiative rolls and Strength (Athletics) checks.

In addition, immediately after you score a Critical Hit, you can move up to half your Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

Nota do Foundry

This feature automatically grants Vantagem on Initiative rolls.

Lantern.name: Lantern
Lantern.description: A Lantern casts Luz Plena in a 30-foot radius and Luz Fraca for an additional 30 feet. As a Ação Bônus, you can lower the hood, reducing the light to Luz Fraca in a 5-foot radius, or raise it again.

Gala.name: Gala
Gala.description:
@Embed[JournalEntry.hotbArtHandouts0.JournalEntryPage.zyXJgTD6m1aoSF7i caption=false classes="right three"]

Humano Guarda do Portão

Though she’s memorized all the keep’s laws, this guard still has much to learn.

By the Books. Gala clings to the keep’s laws—and often recites them aloud—whenever she must make a decision.

Naive. Gala believes that life is fair, people mostly tell the truth, and good always prevails.

Rumores

“I’ve heard the captain of the guard, @UUID[JournalEntry.hotbNpcs00000000.JournalEntryPage.a1gOVKXrvzfgImZ9]{Andrella}, plans to retire soon.” (Falso)

“The keep’s coat of arms honors its cavalry, thirty riders strong. I hope to become one.” (Verdadeiro)

Escudo.name: Escudo
Escudo.description: You gain the Armor Class benefit of a Escudo only if you have training with it.

Haldryck.name: Haldryck
Haldryck.description:
@Embed[JournalEntry.hotbArtHandouts0.JournalEntryPage.iIi1lD49eeYn6WtG caption=false classes="right three"]

Dwarf Innkeeper

Jovial and accommodating, Haldryck is a fast friend to anyone who visits his inn.

Epicurean. Good food and drink are the keys to Haldryck’s heart.

Overseller. Haldryck advertises his inn’s basic necessities—like clean sheets and doors with locks—as luxury amenities.

Rumores

“The food at the tavern is the best in the Borderlands!” (Doubtful)

“My inn is the only place visitors to the keep can stay overnight.” (Falso)

Parry.name: Parry
Parry.description: Trigger: The [[lookup @name lowercase]] is [[lookup @activation.condition activity=aLG3BRZL7P6OEjwd]]. Response: The [[lookup @name lowercase]] adds [[lookup @roll.formula activity=aLG3BRZL7P6OEjwd]] to its AC against that attack, possibly causing it to miss.

Ivlis.name: Ivlis
Ivlis.description:
Secret Cult Lair

Beneath a pretense of charity and goodness, Ivlis is a demon worshiper who leads a wicked cult. She uses deception and skulduggery to advance her power. Though she feigns kindness and compassion in public spaces, Ivlis believes the poor and downtrodden deserve their wretched lot. In battle, her magic is unpredictable.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The [[lookup @name lowercase]] makes three [[/item Chaos Blast]] attacks. She can replace one attack with a use of [[/item Sinister Command]] if available.

Chaos Blast.name: Chaos Blast
Chaos Blast.description: [[/attack extended]]. [[/damage extended]]. Roll [[/r 1d4]] to determine the damage type: 1, Acid; 2, Cold; 3, Fire; 4, Lightning.

Sinister Command.name: Sinister Command
Sinister Command.description:
Sabedoria Saving Throw: DC 12, one criatura [[lookup @name]] can see within 60 feet.

Failure: The alvo has the &Reference[Charmed apply=false] condition until the end of its next turn. While Charmed, the alvo has the &Reference[Incapacitado apply=false] condition.

Commanded.name: Commanded
Commanded.description: The alvo has the &Reference[charmed apply=false] condition. While Charmed, the alvo has the &Reference[Incapacitado apply=false] condition.

Jacko.name: Jacko
Jacko.description:
Halfling Spy for Hire

Jacko advertises his cloak-and-dagger services in seedy places throughout the Borderlands. For the right price, Jacko will trail, rob, rough up, or take out any mark—no questions asked. Satisfied customers parrot his cheesy slogan: “Jacko always has your back-o.”

Cunning Action.name: Cunning Action
Cunning Action.description: [[lookup @name]] takes the &Reference[Dash apply=false], the &Reference[Disengage apply=false], or &Reference[Hide apply=false] action.

Quick Disguise.name: Quick Disguise
Quick Disguise.description: [[lookup @name]] spends 1 minute to disguise himself as a different Humanoid of approximately his height and weight. While Jacko is disguised, a criatura that takes the Study action to inspect Jacko’s appearance can make a [[/skill inv 13]], discerning his disguise on a successful check.

Kalista.name: Kalista
Kalista.description:
@Embed[JournalEntry.hotbArtHandouts0.JournalEntryPage.S0pe3tkg2MUke8xd caption=false classes="right three"]

Dwarf Blacksmith

The keep’s taciturn, hardworking smith prefers to let her hammer do the talking.

Standoffish. Kalista is curt toward people she doesn’t know, especially adventurers.

Stern. Kalista never cracks a smile.

Rumores

“Every now and then, adventurers return from the Caves of Chaos with magic weapons, but most of the time they don’t come back at all.” (Verdadeiro)

“Mind your equipment around oozes. Their touch can corrode even the sturdiest of metals.” (Verdadeiro)

Training.name: Training
Training.description: The [[lookup @name lowercase]] has a +2 bonus to one skill of the DM’s choice and has Vantagem whenever it makes an ability check using that skill.

Kuo-toa Marauder.name: Kuo-toa Marauder
Kuo-toa Marauder.description:
Fishlike Fanatic of the Deep

Kuo-toa have slimy, humanoid bodies and the heads of goggle-eyed deep-sea fish. They claim they once dominated whole worlds, their empires spanning land and sea under the blessings of piscine gods.

Kuo-toa undertake contrived plots to propel themselves to dominance, often kidnapping people to learn their secrets or making dubious sacrifices to bizarre gods. These marauders lurk in wet places, eager to shed blood and claim plunder.

Amphibious.name: Amphibious
Amphibious.description: The [[lookup @name lowercase]] can breathe air and water.

Sunlight Sensitivity.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
Sunlight Sensitivity.description: While in sunlight, the [[lookup @name lowercase]] has Desvantagem on ability checks and attack rolls.

Lenk.name: Lenk
Lenk.description:
@Embed[JournalEntry.hotbArtHandouts0.JournalEntryPage.QVHdjpOzl8sZEOGp caption=false classes="right three"]

Humano Jeweler

This elderly jeweler can identify and appraise any gemstone.

Faultfinder. Lenk has a knack for spotting flaws, be they in things or people.

Pessimistic. Lenk always sees the worst part of any situation.

Rumores

“Your money isn’t safe at the bank. I hear a burglar broke in recently and stole every last coin.” (Partially true; the burglar was unsuccessful)

“Some stones hide things. The next time you’re in an ancient dungeon or old cave, inspect the walls closely. You just might find a secret door.” (Verdadeiro)

Lizardfolk Warden.name: Lizardfolk Warden
Lizardfolk Warden.description:
Reptilian Guardian of Nature

Lizardfolk wardens draw on primal magic to protect nature’s boundaries. These territorial guardians lurk in wetlands and jungles, surfacing from murky pools to track down trespassers and drive them out. Wardens wield weapons and shields fashioned from the husks of giant beetles, snapping turtles, and other mighty criaturas. When these tools fail them, they channel the forces of nature to augment their natural attacks with poison saliva.

Hold Breath.name: Hold Breath
Hold Breath.description: The [[lookup @name lowercase]] can hold its breath for 15 minutes.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The [[lookup @name lowercase]] makes one [[/item Bite]] attack and one [[/item Bone Pike]] attack.

Mallyn.name: Mallyn
Mallyn.description:
@Embed[JournalEntry.hotbArtHandouts0.JournalEntryPage.c1u6Pa3pifl8fayf caption=false classes="right three"]

Humano Traveler

This young wayfarer’s heart is filled with wanderlust.

Easy Come, Easy Go. Mallyn doesn’t get attached to possessions or acquaintances.

Inquisitive. Mallyn eagerly asks strangers lots of questions.

Rumores

“Don’t wander into the fens unless you’re looking for trouble. The lizardfolk there don’t like visitors.” (Verdadeiro)

“My uncle Umbrusk runs the tavern in the keep. He hears all kinds of gossip in the taproom.” (Verdadeiro)

Narthus.name: Narthus
Narthus.description:
Cult Leader's Cruel Understudy

A craven lackey, Narthus serves Ivlis out of fear rather than loyalty. Narthus spends his days groveling before Ivlis and cruelly whipping new initiates to the Cult of Chaos into shape. Narthus’s feral nature leads some cultists to speculate that he was raised by wild animals.

Ivlis prizes Narthus for his obsequity and morbid fascinations. He grows the cult’s ranks through macabre rituals, conscripting the dead to serve the cult’s depraved goals.

Fateful Bolt.name: Fateful Bolt
Fateful Bolt.description: [[/attack extended]]. [[/damage average extended]], and the next jogada de ataque made against the alvo before the end of [[lookup @name]]' next turn has advantage.

Oleira.name: Oleira
Oleira.description:
@Embed[JournalEntry.hotbArtHandouts0.JournalEntryPage.6aNQoD30dHMuthfC caption=false classes="right three"]

Humano Shopkeeper

This merchant and mother of two deals in wares ranging from common trade goods to curious bric-a-brac.

Fastidious. Oleira can’t stand dusty wares. Every item must be spotless.

Parental. Oleira sometimes treats her customers like she does her children.

Rumores

“A hermit, Xanthe, was cast out of the keep for practicing evil magic. I hear she was in a cult. Think of the children!” (Falso)

“The keep’s two outer gate guards, Bartho and Gala, are both so green. I’m not sure which of them I trust less to protect us.” (Verdadeiro)

Pral.name: Pral
Pral.description:
The Most Infamous Bandit of the Borderlands

Pral’s boyishly handsome, self-assured grin graces wanted posters throughout the Borderlands. A self-proclaimed “gentleman thief,” Pral abides by a strict personal code. He never kills, and he always upholds his end of any bargain he makes. A lover of good food, comfortable lodgings, and stylish clothing, Pral squanders the spoils of each robbery on his extravagant lifestyle.

Halfling Baker

Quink is a miserly moneylender.

Frugal. Quink never budges on matters of money.

Garrulous. Conversations with Quink last twice as long as they should.

Rumores

“Good supplies are a sound investment. Ruckus at the provisioner’s shop can outfit you with quality gear.” (Verdadeiro)

“I’ve heard dragons are a bit like bankers—we obsess over every coin. If you ever encounter a dragon, don’t touch its hoard unless you want to meet its wrath.” (Verdadeiro)

Expertise.name: Expertise
Expertise.description:
You gain Expertise in two of your skill proficiencies of your choice. Sleight of Hand and Stealth are recommended if you have proficiency in them.

At Ladino level 6, you gain Expertise in two more of your skill proficiencies of your choice.

Nota do Foundry

You will be prompted for your expertise choices as you level up.

Sneak Attack.name: Sneak Attack
Sneak Attack.description:
You know how to strike subtly and exploit a foe's distraction. Once per turn, you can deal an extra 1d6 damage to one criatura you hit with an jogada de ataque if you have Vantagem on the roll and the attack uses a Finesse or a Ranged weapon. The extra damage's type is the same as the weapon's type.

You don't need Vantagem on the jogada de ataque if at least one of your allies is within 5 feet of the alvo, the ally doesn't have the Incapacitado condition, and you don't have Desvantagem on the jogada de ataque.

The extra damage increases as you gain Ladino levels, as shown in the Sneak Attack column of the Ladino Features table.

Current Sneak Attack Damage: [[lookup @scale.rogue.sneak-attack]]

Nota do Foundry

Your sneak attack damage will automatically scale as you level up. You can select the damage type in the damage roll's dialog box.

Thieves' Cant.name: Thieves' Cant
Thieves' Cant.description:
You picked up various languages in the communities where you plied your roguish talents. You know Thieves' Cant and one other language of your choice, which you choose from the language tables in @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.content24.JournalEntry.phbCreatingAChar.JournalEntryPage.t1WP9VEevo4TOTXw#choose-languages]{Character Creation}.

Witty. Toryn says smart things and always has the last word.

“Castellan Winvarle is the ultimate authority in the keep.” (Verdadeiro)

“The Borderlands are home to all sorts of trades: musicians, mercenaries, treasure-seekers, spies even monsters can have a profession. My advice? Pay them what they ask.” (Verdadeiro)

Spellbook.description:
Your spellbook contains the level 1+ spells you know.

When you begin play, choose four spells from among the level 1+ Spell Cards listed on your class board’s “What You Need to Play” section (five if you are level 2, six if you are level 3). These cards make up your prepared spells. Don’t include spells from your Background Card or Species Card.

Put the spells you haven’t prepared in a pile under this card, and stack your prepared spells near your Class Board.

Recommended Spells. As a Nível 1 Character

As a Multiclass Character

  • Gain the Dado de Ponto de Vida from the Core Mago Traits table.

See the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.content24.JournalEntry.phbCreatingAChar.JournalEntryPage.vcs4jfEKRxPCsgXm]{multiclassing rules} to determine your available spell slots.

Expanding and Replacing a Spellbook

The spells you add to your spellbook as you gain levels reflect your ongoing magical research, but you might find other spells during your adventures that you can add to the book. You could discover a Mago spell on a Spell Scroll, for example, and then copy it into your spellbook.

Copying a Spell into the Book. When you find a level 1+ Mago spell, you can copy it into your spellbook if it's of a level you can prepare and if you have time to copy it. For each level of the spell, the transcription takes 2 hours and costs 50 GP. Afterward you can prepare the spell like the other spells in your spellbook.

Copying the Book. You can copy a spell from your spellbook into another book. This is like copying a new spell into your spellbook but faster, since you already know how to cast the spell. You need spend only 1 hour and 10 GP for each level of the copied spell.

If you lose your spellbook, you can use the same procedure to transcribe the Mago spells that you have prepared into a new spellbook. Filling out the remainder of the new book requires you to find new spells to do so. For this reason, many wizards keep a backup spellbook.

Conjuração.name: Conjuração
Conjuração.description:
As a student of arcane magic, you have learned to cast spells. See the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.content24.JournalEntry.phbSpells0000000.JournalEntryPage.b2QVn25z2N1ykWpf]{rules on spellcasting}. The information below details how you use those rules with Mago spells, which appear in the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.content24.JournalEntry.phbSpells0000000.JournalEntryPage.6AnqLUowgdsqMFvz]{Mago spell list}.

Truques. You know three Mago cantrips of your choice. @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplLight00000]{Light}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplMageHand00]{Mage Hand}, and @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplRayofFrost]{Ray of Frost} are recommended. Whenever you finish a Descanso Longo, you can replace one of your cantrips from this feature with another Mago cantrip of your choice.

When you reach Mago levels 4 and 10, you learn another Mago cantrip of your choice, as shown in the Truques column of the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.content24.JournalEntry.phbWizard0000000.JournalEntryPage.g7cMRWzsgAsEF7zC#class-features]{Mago Features table}.

Spellbook. Your wizardly apprenticeship culminated in the creation of a unique book: your spellbook. It is a Tiny object that weighs 3 pounds, contains 100 pages, and can be read only by you or someone casting @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplIdentify00]{Identify}. Expanding and Replacing a Spellbook

The spells you add to your spellbook as you gain levels reflect your ongoing magical research, but you might find other spells during your adventures that you can add to the book. You could discover a Mago spell on a Spell Scroll, for example, and then copy it into your spellbook.

Abjurer.name: Abjurer
Abjurer.description:
Escudo Companions and Banish Foes

Your study of magic is focused on spells that block, banish, or protect—ending harmful effects, banishing evil influences, and protecting the weak. Abjurers are sought when baleful spirits require exorcism, when locations must be guarded against magical spying, and when portals to other planes of existence must be closed. Adventuring parties value Abjurers for the protection they provide against a variety of hostile magic and other attacks.

Abjuration Savant.name: Abjuration Savant
Abjuration Savant.description:
Escolha two Mago spells from the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.content24.JournalEntry.phbSpells0000000.JournalEntryPage.6AnqLUowgdsqMFvz]{Abjuration school} (change the Grouping mode for easier selection), each of which must be no higher than level 2, and add them to your spellbook for free.

In addition, whenever you gain access to a new level of spell slots in this class, you can add one Mago spell from the Abjuration school to your spellbook for free. The chosen spell must be of a level for which you have spell slots.

Arcane Ward.name: Arcane Ward
Arcane Ward.description:
You can weave magic around yourself for protection. When you cast an Abjuration spell with a spell slot, you can simultaneously use a strand of the spell’s magic to create a magical ward on yourself that lasts until you finish a Descanso Longo. The ward has a Hit Point maximum equal to twice your Mago level plus your Inteligência modifier. Whenever you take damage, the ward takes the damage instead, and if you have any Resistances or Vulnerabilities, apply them before reducing the ward’s Pontos de Vida. If the damage reduces the ward to 0 Pontos de Vida, you take any remaining damage. While the ward has 0 Pontos de Vida, it can’t absorb damage, but its magic remains.

Whenever you cast an Abjuration spell with a spell slot, the ward regains a number of Pontos de Vida equal to twice the level of the spell slot. Alternatively, as a Ação Bônus, you can expend a spell slot, and the ward regains a number of Pontos de Vida equal to twice the level of the spell slot expended.

Once you create the ward, you can’t create it again until you finish a Descanso Longo.

Nota do Foundry

Track the HP of the Ward with the number of uses on this item.

The Create Ward activity has 1 use per Descanso Longo and updates the Arcane Ward to have full uses ("HP").

The Damage Ward activity will reduce the Ward's uses ("HP") by the amount of damage given.

The Restore Ward HP After Casting Spell activity can be used after you use an Abjuration spell. Set the scale value to the spell slot level you used to restore the correct number of uses ("HP").

The Expend Spell Slot for Ward activity allows you to choose a spell slot level, expends it, and restores the correct number of uses ("HP").

Arcane Lock.description:
Target: A closed door, window, gate, container, or hatch you touch

Effect: The alvo is magically locked for the duration. This lock can’t be unlocked by any nonmagical means. You and any criaturas you designate when you cast the spell can open and close the object despite the lock. You can also set a password that, when spoken within 5 feet of the object, unlocks it for 1 minute.

Misty Step.description: Briefly surrounded by silvery mist, you teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.

Protection from Evil and Good.name: Protection from Evil and Good
Protection from Evil and Good.description: Until the spell ends, one willing criatura you touch is protected against criaturas that are Aberrations, Celestials, Elementals, Fey, Fiends, or Morto-vivo. The protection grants several benefits. Creatures of those types have Desvantagem on attack rolls against the alvo. The alvo also can't gain the &Reference[Charmed apply=false] or &Reference[Amedrontado apply=false] conditions from them. If the alvo is already Charmed, or Amedrontado by such a criatura, the alvo has Vantagem on any new teste de resistência against the relevant effect.

Protected.description: Creatures of those types have Desvantagem on attack rolls against the alvo. The alvo also can’t be possessed by or gain the &Reference[Charmed apply=false] or &Reference[Amedrontado apply=false] conditions from them.

Put the spells you haven’t prepared in a pile under this card, and stack your prepared spells near your Class Board.

Becoming a Mago …

As a Nível 1 Character

  • Gain all the traits in the Core Mago Traits table.
  • Gain the Mago's level 1 features, which are listed in the Mago Features table.

As a Multiclass Character

  • Gain the Dado de Ponto de Vida from the Core Mago Traits table.
  • Gain the Mago's level 1 features, which are listed in the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.content24.JournalEntry.phbWizard0000000.JournalEntryPage.g7cMRWzsgAsEF7zC#class-features]{Mago Features table}. See the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.content24.JournalEntry.phbCreatingAChar.JournalEntryPage.vcs4jfEKRxPCsgXm]{multiclassing rules} to determine your available spell slots.

Expanding and Replacing a Spellbook

The spells you add to your spellbook as you gain levels reflect your ongoing magical research, but you might find other spells during your adventures that you can add to the book. You could discover a Mago spell on a Spell Scroll, for example, and then copy it into your spellbook.

Copying a Spell into the Book. When you find a level 1+ Mago spell, you can copy it into your spellbook if it's of a level you can prepare and if you have time to copy it. For each level of the spell, the transcription takes 2 hours and costs 50 GP. Afterward you can prepare the spell like the other spells in your spellbook.

Copying the Book. You can copy a spell from your spellbook into another book. This is like copying a new spell into your spellbook but faster, since you already know how to cast the spell. You need spend only 1 hour and 10 GP for each level of the copied spell.

If you lose your spellbook, you can use the same procedure to transcribe the Mago spells that you have prepared into a new spellbook. Filling out the remainder of the new book requires you to find new spells to do so. For this reason, many wizards keep a backup spellbook.

Conjuração.name: Conjuração
Conjuração.description:
As a student of arcane magic, you have learned to cast spells. See the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.content24.JournalEntry.phbSpells0000000.JournalEntryPage.b2QVn25z2N1ykWpf]{rules on spellcasting}. The information below details how you use those rules with Mago spells, which appear in the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.content24.JournalEntry.phbSpells0000000.JournalEntryPage.6AnqLUowgdsqMFvz]{Mago spell list}.

Truques. You know three Mago cantrips of your choice. @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplLight00000]{Light}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplMageHand00]{Mage Hand}, and @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplRayofFrost]{Ray of Frost} are recommended. Whenever you finish a Descanso Longo, you can replace one of your cantrips from this feature with another Mago cantrip of your choice.

When you reach Mago levels 4 and 10, you learn another Mago cantrip of your choice, as shown in the Truques column of the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.content24.JournalEntry.phbWizard0000000.JournalEntryPage.g7cMRWzsgAsEF7zC#class-features]{Mago Features table}.

Spellbook. Your wizardly apprenticeship culminated in the creation of a unique book: your spellbook. It is a Tiny object that weighs 3 pounds, contains 100 pages, and can be read only by you or someone casting @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplIdentify00]{Identify}. You determine the book's appearance and materials, such as a gilt-edged tome or a collection of vellum bound with twine.

The book contains the level 1+ spells you know. It starts with six level 1 Mago spells of your choice. @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplDetectMagi]{Detect Magic}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplFeatherFal]{Feather Fall}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplMageArmor0]{Mage Armor}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplMagicMissi]{Magic Missile}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplSleep00000]{Sleep}, and @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplThunderwav]{Thunderwave} are recommended.

Whenever you gain a Mago level after 1, add two Mago spells of your choice to your spellbook. Each of these spells must be of a level for which you have spell slots, as shown in the Mago Features table. The spells are the culmination of arcane research you do regularly.

Espaços de Magia. The Mago Features table shows how many spell slots you have to cast your level 1+ spells. You regain all expended slots when you finish a Descanso Longo.

Magias Preparadas of Nível 1+. You prepare the list of level 1+ spells that are available for you to cast with this feature. To do so, choose four spells from your spellbook. The chosen spells must be of a level for which you have spell slots.

The number of spells on your list increases as you gain Mago levels, as shown in the Magias Preparadas column of the Mago Features table. Whenever that number increases, choose additional Mago spells until the number of spells on your list matches the number in the table. The chosen spells must be of a level for which you have spell slots. For example, if you're a level 3 Mago, your list of prepared spells can include six spells of levels 1 and 2 in any combination, chosen from your spellbook.

Changing Your Magias Preparadas. Whenever you finish a Descanso Longo, you can change your list of prepared spells, replacing any of the spells there with spells from your spellbook.

Atributo de Conjuração. Inteligência is your spellcasting ability for your Mago spells.

Foco de Conjuração. You can use an Arcane Focus or your spellbook as a Foco de Conjuração for your Mago spells.

Ritual Adept.name: Ritual Adept
Ritual Adept.description: You can cast any spell as a @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.content24.JournalEntry.phbSpells0000000.JournalEntryPage.YSB1QtxZW2BI9f4Y#casting-without-slots]{Ritual} if that spell has the Ritual tag and the spell is in your spellbook. You needn't have the spell prepared, but you must read from the book to cast a spell in this way.

Arcane Recovery.name: Arcane Recovery
Arcane Recovery.description:
You can regain some of your magical energy by studying your spellbook. When you finish a Descanso Curto, you can choose expended spell slots to recover. The spell slots can have a combined level equal to no more than half your Mago level (round up), and none of the slots can be level 6 or higher. For example, if you're a level 4 Mago, you can recover up to two levels' worth of spell slots, regaining either one level 2 spell slot or two level 1 spell slots.

Once you use this feature, you can't do so again until you finish a Descanso Longo.
