Nota do Foundry

Since you can select the slots you will have to manually adjust your available slots. This feature can be used to track the one-time use though.

Mãos Flamejantes.name: Mãos Flamejantes
Mãos Flamejantes.description:
A thin sheet of flames shoots forth from you. Each criatura in a 15-foot Cone makes a Dexterity teste de resistência, taking 3d6 dano de fogo on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

Flammable objects in the Cone that aren't being worn or carried start burning.

Usando um Espaço de Magia de Círculo Superior. The damage increases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above 1.

Feather Fall.name: Feather Fall
Feather Fall.description: Escolha up to five falling criaturas dentro do alcance. A falling criatura's rate of descent slows to 60 feet per round until the spell ends. If a criatura lands before the spell ends, the criatura takes no damage from the fall, and the spell ends for that criatura.

Light.name: Light
Light.description:
You touch one Large or smaller object that isn't being worn or carried by someone else. Until the spell ends, the object sheds Luz Plena in a 20-foot radius and Luz Fraca for an additional 20 feet. The light can be colored as you like.

Covering the object with something opaque blocks the light. The spell ends if you cast it again.

Mage Armor.name: Mage Armor
Mage Armor.description: You touch a willing criatura who isn't wearing armor. Until the spell ends, the alvo's base AC becomes 13 plus its Dexterity modifier. The spell ends early if the alvo dons armor.

Mage Armor.name: Mage Armor
Mage Armor.description: The alvo's base AC becomes 13 + its Dexterity modifier.

Magic Missile.name: Magic Missile
Magic Missile.description:
You create three glowing darts of magical force. Each dart strikes a criatura of your choice that you can see dentro do alcance. A dart deals 1d4 + 1 Force damage to its alvo. The darts all strike simultaneously, and you can direct them to hit one criatura or several.

Usando um Espaço de Magia de Círculo Superior. The spell creates one more dart for each spell slot level above 1.

[[2 + @item.level]]{Nível [[lookup @item.level]] darts}

Ray of Frost.name: Ray of Frost
Ray of Frost.description:
A frigid beam of blue-white light streaks toward a criatura dentro do alcance. Make a ranged spell attack against the alvo. On a hit, it takes 1d8 Cold damage, and its Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.

Aprimoramento de Truque. The damage increases by 1d8 when you reach levels 5 (2d8), 11 (3d8), and 17 (4d8).

Reduced Movement.name: Reduced Movement
Reduced Movement.description: The alvo's Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.

Shocking Grasp.name: Shocking Grasp
Shocking Grasp.description:
Lightning springs from you to a criatura that you try to touch. Make a melee spell attack against the alvo. On a hit, the alvo takes 1d8 Lightning damage, and it can't make Opportunity Attacks until the start of its next turn.

Aprimoramento de Truque. The damage increases by 1d8 when you reach levels 5 (2d8), 11 (3d8), and 17 (4d8).

Shocked.name: Shocked
Shocked.description: The alvo can’t make Opportunity Attacks until the start of its next turn.

Sleep.name: Sleep
Sleep.description:
Each criatura of your choice in a 5-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point dentro do alcance must succeed on a Sabedoria teste de resistência or have the &Reference[incapacitated apply=false] condition until the end of its next turn, at which point it must repeat the save. If the alvo fails the second save, the alvo has the &Reference[unconscious] condition for the duration. The spell ends on a alvo if it takes damage or someone within 5 feet of it takes an action to shake it out of the spell's effect.

Creatures that don't sleep, such as elves, or that have Immunity to the Exhaustion condition automatically succeed on saves against this spell.

Sleeping.name: Sleeping
Sleeping.description: The alvo has the &Reference[incapacitated apply=false] condition until the end of its next turn, at which point it must repeat the save. If the alvo fails the second save, the alvo has the &Reference[unconscious] condition for the duration. The spell ends on a alvo if it takes damage or someone within 5 feet of it takes an action to shake it out of the spell’s effect.

Thunderwave.name: Thunderwave
Thunderwave.description:
You unleash a wave of thunderous energy. Each criatura in a 15-foot Cubo originating from you makes a Constitution teste de resistência. On a failed save, a criatura takes 2d8 Thunder damage and is pushed 10 feet away from you. On a successful save, a criatura takes half as much damage only.

In addition, unsecured objects that are entirely within the Cubo are pushed 10 feet away from you, and a thunderous boom is audible within 300 feet.

Usando um Espaço de Magia de Círculo Superior. The damage increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above 1.

Scholar.name: Scholar
Scholar.description: While studying magic, you also specialized in another field of study. Escolha one of the following skills in which you have proficiency: Arcana, História, Investigation, Medicina, Nature, or Religião. You have Expertise in the chosen skill.

Color Spray.name: Color Spray
Color Spray.description: You launch a dazzling array of flashing, colorful light. Each criatura in a 15-foot Cone originating from you must succeed on a Constitution teste de resistência or have the &Reference[blinded apply=false] condition until the end of your next turn.

Tasha's Hideous Laughter.name: Tasha's Hideous Laughter
Tasha's Hideous Laughter.description:
One criatura of your choice that you can see dentro do alcance makes a Sabedoria teste de resistência. On a failed save, it has the &Reference[prone apply=false] and &Reference[incapacitated apply=false] conditions for the duration. During that time, it laughs uncontrollably if it's capable of laughter, and it can't end the Prone condition on itself.

At the end of each of its turns and each time it takes damage, it makes another [[/save ability=wis dc=@attributes.spell.dc]] teste de resistência. The alvo has Vantagem on the save if the save is triggered by damage. On a successful save, the spell ends.

Usando um Espaço de Magia de Círculo Superior. You can alvo one additional criatura for each spell slot level about 1.

Uncontrollable Laughter.name: Uncontrollable Laughter
Uncontrollable Laughter.description:
has the &Reference[prone apply=false] and &Reference[incapacitated apply=false] conditions for the duration. During that time, it laughs uncontrollably if it’s capable of laughter, and it can’t end the Prone condition on itself.

At the end of each of its turns and each time it takes damage, it makes another [[/save ability=wis dc=@attributes.spell.dc]] teste de resistência. The alvo has Vantagem on the save if the save is triggered by damage. On a successful save, the spell ends.

Evoker.name: Evoker
Evoker.description:
Create Explosive Elemental Effects

Your studies focus on magic that creates powerful elemental effects such as bitter cold, searing flame, rolling thunder, crackling lightning, and burning acid. Some Evokers find employment in military forces, serving as artillery to blast armies from afar. Others use their power to protect others, while some seek their own gain.

Evocation Savant.name: Evocation Savant
Evocation Savant.description:
Escolha two Mago spells from the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.content24.JournalEntry.phbSpells0000000.JournalEntryPage.6AnqLUowgdsqMFvz]{Evocation school} (change the Grouping mode to "School" for easier selection), each of which must be no higher than level 2, and add them to your spellbook for free.

In addition, whenever you gain access to a new level of spell slots in this class, you can add one Mago spell from the Evocation school to your spellbook for free. The chosen spell must be of a level for which you have spell slots.

Potent Cantrip.name: Potent Cantrip
Potent Cantrip.description:
Your damaging cantrips affect even criaturas that avoid the brunt of the effect. When you cast a cantrip at a criatura and you miss with the jogada de ataque or the alvo succeeds on a teste de resistência against the cantrip, the alvo takes half the cantrip's damage (if any) but suffers no additional effect from the cantrip.

Nota do Foundry

With their token selected you can either right click on the damage roll's chat card and select  Apply Half Damage or click the "1/2" button and then the  Apply button.

Invisibility.name: Invisibility
Invisibility.description:
A criatura you touch has the &Reference[invisible apply=false] condition until the spell ends. The spell ends early immediately after the alvo makes an jogada de ataque, deals damage, or casts a spell.

Usando um Espaço de Magia de Círculo Superior. You can alvo one additional criatura for each spell slot level above 2.

Invisível.name: Invisível
Invisível.description: The spell ends early immediately after the alvo makes an jogada de ataque, deals damage, or casts a spell.

Melf's Acid Arrow.name: Melf's Acid Arrow
Melf's Acid Arrow.description:
A shimmering green arrow streaks toward a alvo dentro do alcance and bursts in a spray of acid. Make a ranged spell attack against the alvo. On a hit, the alvo takes 4d4 Acid damage and 2d4 Acid damage at the end of its next turn. On a miss, the arrow splashes the alvo with acid for half as much of the initial damage only.

Usando um Espaço de Magia de Círculo Superior. The damage (both initial and later) increases by 1d4 for each spell slot level above 2.

Lingering Acid.name: Lingering Acid
Lingering Acid.description: On a hit, the alvo takes 4d4 Acid damage and [[/damage 2d4 type=acid]] (plus 1d4 per spell slot level above 2) Acid damage at the end of its next turn.

Misty Step.name: Misty Step
Misty Step.description: Briefly surrounded by silvery mist, you teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.

Shatter.name: Shatter
Shatter.description:
A loud noise erupts from a point of your choice dentro do alcance. Each criatura in a 10-foot-radius Sphere centered there makes a Constitution teste de resistência, taking 3d8 Thunder damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

A nonmagical object that isn't being worn or carried also takes the damage if it's in the spell's area.

Usando um Espaço de Magia de Círculo Superior. The damage increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above 2.

Spellbook.description:
Your spellbook contains the level 1+ spells you know.

When you begin play, choose four spells from among the level 1+ Spell Cards listed on your class board’s “What You Need to Play” section (five if you are level 2, six if you are level 3). These cards make up your prepared spells. Don’t include spells from your Background Card or Species Card.

A thin sheet of flames shoots forth from you. Each criatura in a 15-foot Cone makes a Dexterity teste de resistência, taking 3d6 dano de fogo on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

Flammable objects in the Cone that aren't being worn or carried start burning.

Usando um Espaço de Magia de Círculo Superior. The damage increases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above 1.

Feather Fall.name: Feather Fall
Feather Fall.description: Escolha up to five falling criaturas dentro do alcance. A falling criatura's rate of descent slows to 60 feet per round until the spell ends. If a criatura lands before the spell ends, the criatura takes no damage from the fall, and the spell ends for that criatura.

Light.name: Light
Light.description:
You touch one Large or smaller object that isn't being worn or carried by someone else. Until the spell ends, the object sheds Luz Plena in a 20-foot radius and Luz Fraca for an additional 20 feet. The light can be colored as you like.

Covering the object with something opaque blocks the light. The spell ends if you cast it again.

Mage Armor.name: Mage Armor
Mage Armor.description: You touch a willing criatura who isn't wearing armor. Until the spell ends, the alvo's base AC becomes 13 plus its Dexterity modifier. The spell ends early if the alvo dons armor.

Mage Armor.name: Mage Armor
Mage Armor.description: The alvo's base AC becomes 13 + its Dexterity modifier.

Magic Missile.name: Magic Missile
Magic Missile.description:
You create three glowing darts of magical force. Each dart strikes a criatura of your choice that you can see dentro do alcance. A dart deals 1d4 + 1 Force damage to its alvo. The darts all strike simultaneously, and you can direct them to hit one criatura or several.

Usando um Espaço de Magia de Círculo Superior. The spell creates one more dart for each spell slot level above 1.

[[2 + @item.level]]{Nível [[lookup @item.level]] darts}

Ray of Frost.name: Ray of Frost
Ray of Frost.description:
A frigid beam of blue-white light streaks toward a criatura dentro do alcance. Make a ranged spell attack against the alvo. On a hit, it takes 1d8 Cold damage, and its Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.

Aprimoramento de Truque. The damage increases by 1d8 when you reach levels 5 (2d8), 11 (3d8), and 17 (4d8).

Reduced Movement.name: Reduced Movement
Reduced Movement.description: The alvo's Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.

Shocking Grasp.name: Shocking Grasp
Shocking Grasp.description:
Lightning springs from you to a criatura that you try to touch. Make a melee spell attack against the alvo. On a hit, the alvo takes 1d8 Lightning damage, and it can't make Opportunity Attacks until the start of its next turn.

Aprimoramento de Truque. The damage increases by 1d8 when you reach levels 5 (2d8), 11 (3d8), and 17 (4d8).

Shocked.name: Shocked
Shocked.description: The alvo can’t make Opportunity Attacks until the start of its next turn.

Sleep.name: Sleep
Sleep.description:
Each criatura of your choice in a 5-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point dentro do alcance must succeed on a Sabedoria teste de resistência or have the &Reference[incapacitated apply=false] condition until the end of its next turn, at which point it must repeat the save. If the alvo fails the second save, the alvo has the &Reference[unconscious] condition for the duration. The spell ends on a alvo if it takes damage or someone within 5 feet of it takes an action to shake it out of the spell's effect.

Creatures that don't sleep, such as elves, or that have Immunity to the Exhaustion condition automatically succeed on saves against this spell.

Sleeping.name: Sleeping
Sleeping.description: The alvo has the &Reference[incapacitated apply=false] condition until the end of its next turn, at which point it must repeat the save. If the alvo fails the second save, the alvo has the &Reference[unconscious] condition for the duration. The spell ends on a alvo if it takes damage or someone within 5 feet of it takes an action to shake it out of the spell’s effect.

Thunderwave.name: Thunderwave
Thunderwave.description:
You unleash a wave of thunderous energy. Each criatura in a 15-foot Cubo originating from you makes a Constitution teste de resistência. On a failed save, a criatura takes 2d8 Thunder damage and is pushed 10 feet away from you. On a successful save, a criatura takes half as much damage only.

In addition, unsecured objects that are entirely within the Cubo are pushed 10 feet away from you, and a thunderous boom is audible within 300 feet.

Usando um Espaço de Magia de Círculo Superior. The damage increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above 1.

Scholar.name: Scholar
Scholar.description: While studying magic, you also specialized in another field of study. Escolha one of the following skills in which you have proficiency: Arcana, História, Investigation, Medicina, Nature, or Religião. You have Expertise in the chosen skill.

Color Spray.name: Color Spray
Color Spray.description: You launch a dazzling array of flashing, colorful light. Each criatura in a 15-foot Cone originating from you must succeed on a Constitution teste de resistência or have the &Reference[blinded apply=false] condition until the end of your next turn.

Tasha's Hideous Laughter.name: Tasha's Hideous Laughter
Tasha's Hideous Laughter.description:
One criatura of your choice that you can see dentro do alcance makes a Sabedoria teste de resistência. On a failed save, it has the &Reference[prone apply=false] and &Reference[incapacitated apply=false] conditions for the duration. During that time, it laughs uncontrollably if it's capable of laughter, and it can't end the Prone condition on itself.

At the end of each of its turns and each time it takes damage, it makes another [[/save ability=wis dc=@attributes.spell.dc]] teste de resistência. The alvo has Vantagem on the save if the save is triggered by damage. On a successful save, the spell ends.

Usando um Espaço de Magia de Círculo Superior. You can alvo one additional criatura for each spell slot level about 1.

Xanthe.description:
@Embed[JournalEntry.hotbArtHandouts0.JournalEntryPage.DL74QYd8WgX21TVz caption=false classes="right three"]

Elf Hermit

One of the Borderlands’ oldest and wisest residents was banished from the keep for crimes she didn’t commit.

Bad Reputation. Xanthe was wrongfully exiled for using occult magic.

Distrustful. Xanthe doesn’t trust strangers.

Rumores

“A spy named Jacko prowls the fens. Be wary if you meet him. He’ll do anything for coin—even kill.” (Verdadeiro)

“The temple’s head priest is a demon worshiper.” (Partially true; Xanthe is referring to Ivlis, the former priest)

Yvette.name: Yvette
Yvette.description:
@Embed[JournalEntry.hotbArtHandouts0.JournalEntryPage.rmKQidDVmrBmSckW caption=false classes="right three"]

Humano Bank Guard

This corrupt guard exploits her station for selfish ends.

Bitter. Yvette thinks the world owes her.

Grifter. Yvette is always hunting for new ways to get rich quick.

Rumores

“There’s an alms box at the temple that usually contains a few gold pieces. I hear Fazzir doesn’t even lock it.” (Verdadeiro)

“If you find yourself face to face with an owlbear, just play dead. It will quickly get bored and move on.” (Falso)

Animated Flying Sword.description:
Mundane Object Come to Life

Animated flying swords move as if wielded by unseen warriors. Whether an animated blade is newly forged or a constellation of broken fragments, the object behaves the same.

Bandit.name: Bandit
Bandit.description:
Criminal and Scoundrel

Bandits use the threat of violence to take what they want. Such criminals include gang members, desperadoes, and lawless mercenaries. Yet not all bandits are motivated by greed. Some are driven to lives of crime by unjust laws, desperation, or the threats of merciless leaders.

The alvo has the &Reference[Poisoned apply=false] condition and repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

While Poisoned, the alvo has the &Reference[Paralyzed apply=false] condition.

Commoner.name: Commoner
Commoner.description:
Everyday folk

Commoners constitute the majority of people who don’t pursue magical talents, extraordinary training, or a life of adventure. Some are generous, helpful sorts, while others are more cautious in sharing what they have.

Dragon of Curiosity and Community

Copper dragon wyrmlings venture into the world seeking to make friends and discover wonders. They sometimes get into trouble, but those who help them can become their friends for life.

Cultist.description:
Doomsayer and Fanatic

Cultists devote themselves to their faith’s leaders and otherworldly masters. While this zeal grants cultists no magical powers, it gives them remarkable resolve in the face of threats. Cultists perform much of a cult’s mundane work, which might include evangelism, criminal acts, or serving as sacrifices.

Engulf.description:
The [[lookup @name lowercase]] moves up to its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks. The [[lookup @name lowercase]] fills its entire space and can hold one Large criatura or up to four Medium or Small criaturas inside itself at a time. The cube can move through the spaces of Large or smaller criaturas if it has room inside itself to contain them.

Dexterity Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=5o0Bh8PQaojx5XMx]], each criatura whose space the [[lookup @name lowercase]] enters for the first time during this move.

Failure: [[/damage average]] damage, and the alvo is engulfed. An engulfed alvo has the &Reference[restrained apply=false] condition, has &Reference[total cover apply=false], can't cast spells, and takes [[/damage]] Acid damage at the start of each of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]'s turns. When the [[lookup @name lowercase]] moves, the engulfed alvo moves with it. An engulfed alvo can try to escape by taking an action to make a [[/check ability=str skill=ath dc=@abilities.str.dc]] check. On a successful check, the alvo escapes and enters the nearest unoccupied space.

Success: Half damage, and the alvo moves to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]'s. If there is no unoccupied space, the alvo fails the save instead.

Total Cover, Suffocating & Restrained.name: Total Cover, Suffocating & Restrained
Total Cover, Suffocating & Restrained.description: An engulfed alvo is &Reference[suffocating], can’t cast spells with a Verbal component, has the &Reference[Restrained apply=false] condition, and takes [[/damage average 3d6 type=acid]] damage at the start of each of the user's turns.

Giant Centipede.name: Giant Centipede
Giant Centipede.description:
Many-Legged Arthropod

Giant centipedes are monstrous arthropods found in caves, dungeons, and other subterranean environments. A giant centipede can skitter up inclines with ease, and its venomous bite carries a painful sting.

Gnoll Warrior.description:
Fiend in Feral Flesh

Gnoll warriors crave endless slaughter but quickly grow bored with the prey they kill and the treasures they plunder. Nevertheless, they’re enraged by the thought of anyone else having what’s theirs, compelling them to ruin what they can’t take with them.

Rampage.description: Immediately after dealing damage to a criatura that has half its Pontos de Vida or fewer remaining, the gnoll moves up to half its Speed, and it makes one [[/item Rend]] attack.

Guards protect people, places, and things, either for pay or from a sense of duty. They might perform their duties vigilantly or distractedly. Some raise alarms at the first sign of danger and defend their charges with their lives. Others flee outright if their compensation doesn’t match the danger they face. They’re perceptive, but most have little martial training. They might be bouncers, lookouts, members of a city watch, or other keen-eyed warriors.

Shape-Shift.description: The [[lookup @name lowercase]] shape-shifts to resemble a [[lookup @alvo.affects.special activity=EU2q25V5hIaM1ZlR]] object while retaining its game statistics, or it returns to its true blob form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn’t transformed.

Minotaur of Baphomet.name: Minotaur of Baphomet
Minotaur of Baphomet.description:
Berserker of the Demon Lord of Beasts

Baphomet, Demon Lord of Beasts, claims to have created minotaurs and demands their worship. These brutes resemble the hulking, horned demon lord more than others of their kind, and they wreak havoc in that foul immortal’s name. Rarely, non-minotaurs cursed by magic-users or spiteful deities might transform into these monsters.

Gore.name: Gore
Gore.description: [[/attack extended]]. [[/damage extended average]]. If the alvo is a [[lookup @alvo.affects.special activity=iBenqFiBu40bUxkH]] criatura and the [[lookup @name lowercase]] [[lookup @activation.condition activity=iBenqFiBu40bUxkH]] straight toward it immediately before the hit, the alvo takes an extra [[/damage 3d6 type=piercing average]] damage and has the &Reference[Prone apply=false] condition.

Prone.name: Prone
Prone.description: The alvo has the &Reference[Prone apply=false] condition if the attacking criatura used its moving attack feature.

Noble.name: Noble
Noble.description:
Royal and Rich Folk

Nobles encompass a variety of people with social influence. They might be rulers, wealthy merchants, callous bureaucrats, or the idle elite.

NPC Creature Sizes

If you use this card to represent an NPC, the NPC’s size depends on the species listed on their NPC Card as follows:

Dwarf: Medium

Elf: Medium

Halfling: Small

Humano: Medium

Parry.name: Parry
Parry.description: Trigger: The [[lookup @name lowercase]] is [[lookup @activation.condition activity=aLG3BRZL7P6OEjwd]]. Response: The [[lookup @name lowercase]] adds [[lookup @roll.formula activity=aLG3BRZL7P6OEjwd]] to its AC against that attack, possibly causing it to miss.

Nothic.name: Nothic
Nothic.description:
Witness to the Weird

Consumed by their thirst for forbidden knowledge, nothics are cursed lore seekers transformed by secrets never meant to be known. The bodies of these former scholars are warped into otherworldly shapes, each with a head dominated by a gigantic, unblinking eye.

Rotting Gaze.name: Rotting Gaze
Rotting Gaze.description:
Constitution Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=k4jetEkSCPApNFgz]], [[lookup @alvo.affects.labels.statblock activity=k4jetEkSCPApNFgz]] the [[lookup @name lowercase]] can see within [[lookup @range.value activity=k4jetEkSCPApNFgz]] feet.

Failure: [[/damage average]] damage.

Success: Half damage.

Weird Intuição.name: Weird Intuição
Weird Intuição.description:
Sabedoria Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=o6eFmn0HWGbQjzdG]], one [[lookup @alvo.affects.type activity=o6eFmn0HWGbQjzdG]] the [[lookup @name lowercase]] can see within [[lookup @range.value activity=o6eFmn0HWGbQjzdG]] feet.

Failure: The [[lookup @name lowercase]] magically learns one fact or secret about the alvo.

Ogre.name: Ogre
Ogre.description:
Raging Hulk and Hoarder

Ogres are 10-foot-tall brutes that overwhelm their foes and take what spoils they please. Ogre raiders ally with other evil forces in return for food, riches, and promises of battle.

Ogre Zombie.name: Ogre Zombie
Ogre Zombie.description:
Relentless Reanimated Corpse

Ogre zombies serve as tireless labor and undying weapons of war. These massive zombies possess the size and strength to break through barriers that repel smaller zombies.

Morto-vivo Fortitude.name: Morto-vivo Fortitude
Morto-vivo Fortitude.description: If damage reduces the [[lookup @name lowercase]] to 0 Pontos de Vida, it makes a Constitution teste de resistência (DC 5 plus the damage taken) unless the damage is Radiante or from a Critical Hit. On a successful save, the [[lookup @name lowercase]] drops to 1 Hit Point instead.

Owlbear.name: Owlbear
Owlbear.description:
Magically Perfected Predator

Created long ago by mages, owlbears combine keen avian eyes, thick feathers, and a tearing beak with a mighty bearlike frame. Despite their magical origins, owlbears have propagated and spread to wildernesses across the multiverse. They are tenacious hunters that might track prey over miles and rarely give up their hunts.

Red Dragon Wyrmling.name: Red Dragon Wyrmling
Red Dragon Wyrmling.description:
Dragon of Greed and Devastation

Red dragon wyrmlings are born destroyers. From a young age, they delight in igniting objects and criaturas alike. They sometimes restrain themselves from scorching criaturas to instead bully others into following their orders and bringing them gifts.

Fire Breath.name: Fire Breath
Fire Breath.description:
Dexterity Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=bDqgmtLG3zcVuqdi]], each [[lookup @alvo.affects.type activity=bDqgmtLG3zcVuqdi]] in a [[lookup @alvo.template.size activity=bDqgmtLG3zcVuqdi]]-foot Cone.

Failure: [[/damage average]] damage.

Success: Half damage.

Skeleton.name: Skeleton
Skeleton.description:
Ossified Evil

Skeletons are reanimated Humanoid bones bearing the equipment they had in life. They have rudimentary faculties and greater agility than zombies and similar shambling corpses.

Sprite Skirmisher.name: Sprite Skirmisher
Sprite Skirmisher.description:
Elusive Defender of Fey Realms

Sprites are wee spirits of nature that can see the innate goodness or wickedness of other criaturas. Those that enter their realms with good intentions might be treated with tiny feasts and celebrations. The wicked face nasty tricks and bold ambushes at the hands of invisible sprite defenders.

Enchanting Bow.name: Enchanting Bow
Enchanting Bow.description: [[/attack extended]]. [[/damage average extended]], and the alvo has the &Reference[Charmed apply=false] condition until the start of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]'s next turn.

Charmed.name: Charmed
Charmed.description: The alvo has the &Reference[Charmed apply=false] condition until the start of the attacking criatura's next turn.

Heart Sight.name: Heart Sight
Heart Sight.description:
Carisma Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=NqVrZShDV1L3zBA3]], one [[lookup @alvo.affects.type activity=NqVrZShDV1L3zBA3]] within [[lookup @range.value activity=NqVrZShDV1L3zBA3]] feet the [[lookup @name lowercase]] can see (Celestials, Fiends, and Morto-vivo automatically fail the save).

Failure: The [[lookup @name lowercase]] knows the alvo’s emotions and alignment.

Invisibility.name: Invisibility
Invisibility.description: The [[lookup @name lowercase]] casts @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplInvisibili]{Invisibility} on itself, requiring no spell components and using Carisma as the spellcasting ability.

FAek73jM5CyQOO60.name: Invisibility
FAek73jM5CyQOO60.description:
A criatura you touch has the &Reference[invisible apply=false] condition until the spell ends. The spell ends early immediately after the alvo makes an jogada de ataque, deals damage, or casts a spell.

Usando um Espaço de Magia de Círculo Superior. You can alvo one additional criatura for each spell slot level above 2.

Invisível.name: Invisível
Invisível.description: The spell ends early immediately after the alvo makes an jogada de ataque, deals damage, or casts a spell.

Blurred Form.name: Blurred Form
Blurred Form.description: Attack rolls against the [[lookup @name lowercase]] are made with Desvantagem unless the [[lookup @name lowercase]] has the Incapacitado condition.

Death Burst.name: Death Burst
Death Burst.description:
The [[lookup @name lowercase]] explodes [[lookup @activation.condition activity=1SfqWSp7RSyHgG4b]].

Dexterity Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=1SfqWSp7RSyHgG4b]], each [[lookup @alvo.affects.type activity=1SfqWSp7RSyHgG4b]] in a [[lookup @alvo.template.size activity=1SfqWSp7RSyHgG4b]]-foot Emanation originating from the [[lookup @name lowercase]].

Failure: [[/damage average]] damage.

Success: Half damage.

Steam Breath.name: Steam Breath
Steam Breath.description:
Constitution Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=5iI1KQRWrdMGh9sy]], each criatura in a [[lookup @alvo.template.size activity=5iI1KQRWrdMGh9sy]]-foot Cone.

Failure: [[/damage average]] damage, and the alvo’s Speed decreases by 10 feet until the end of the [[lookup @name lowercase]] next turn..

Success: Half damage.

Failure or Success: Being underwater doesn’t grant Resistance to this dano de fogo.

Stirge.name: Stirge
Stirge.description:
Notorious, Clinging Bloodsucker

Stirges are bat-size vermin with dagger-length proboscises that attach to other criaturas and drain life from them. Stirges are most active at night and hide in shadowy places during the day. If disturbed, they take flight and defend themselves.

Proboscis.name: Proboscis
Proboscis.description:
[[/attack extended]]. [[/damage average extended]]. If the alvo is a criatura, and the [[lookup @name lowercase]] attaches to the alvo. While attached, the [[lookup @name lowercase]] can’t make Proboscis attacks, and the alvo takes [[/damage average activity=5xwoPMBiaRBqjFav]] damage at the start of each of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]'s turns.

The [[lookup @name lowercase]] can detach itself by spending 5 feet of its movement. The alvo or a criatura within 5 feet of it can detach the [[lookup @name lowercase]] as an action.

Sunlight Sensitivity.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
Sunlight Sensitivity.description: While in sunlight, the [[lookup @name lowercase]] has Desvantagem on ability checks and attack rolls.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The [[lookup @name lowercase]] makes two attacks, using [[/item .mmNecroticSword0]] or [[/item .mmNecroticBow000]] in any combination. It can replace one attack with a use of [[/item .mmLifeDrain00000]].

Drink Life.name: Drink Life
Drink Life.description:
Life Drain.

Constitution Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=FA4Mt9cXsYfHDDcs]], one [[lookup @alvo.affects.type activity=FA4Mt9cXsYfHDDcs]] within [[lookup @range.value activity=FA4Mt9cXsYfHDDcs]] feet.

Failure: [[/damage average]] damage, and the alvo’s Hit Point maximum decreases by an amount equal to the damage taken.

Zombie.name: Zombie
Zombie.description:
Relentless Animated Corpse

Zombies are unthinking, reanimated corpses, often gruesomely marred by decay. They serve whatever supernatural force animates them—typically evil necromancers or fiendish spirits.
